projects.title: AMPLIFYHER
projects.description:
Amplify(HER) is the first-ever zine made for and by undocumented women of the Asian diaspora. 
Accomplishments included:

- Facilitated communication with artists, resulting in 20 published submissions with compensation provided for each submitter
- Lead director of promotional video and storyline for IndieGoGo campaign 
- Curated tone and design of zine, in collaboration with the board and team of three graphic designers
- Researched audience and logistical details to determine project outreach strategy and internal timelines, including managing project budget of $13,000 from the Asian Women Giving Circle
